_comment: THE SONG CATALOGUE. Read public/audio/README.md before adding anything.
This file ships EMPTY on purpose. Every track here is a real audio file that
someone holds the rights to, and this repository does not contain any yet.
Nothing is listed that does not exist on disk, and the player renders an
honest 'no music added yet' state rather than naming songs that cannot play.
1. Put the file in this folder, e.g. /audio/ta-love-01.mp3
id       unique, stable, lowercase. Changing it resets shuffle history.
title    the real name of the track. Never invented.
artist   the real performer or composer. Omit for unattributed audio.
language BCP-47 primary subtag, e.g. 'ta' or 'en'. Drives language matching.
mood     free-form tag. 'love' is what the love-song filter looks for.
src      path relative to the site root, e.g. '/audio/ta-love-01.mp3'.
Must be under /audio/ with an audio extension. Absolute and
protocol-relative URLs are rejected on purpose - see README.md.
credit   who to attribute. Required by a CC BY or similar licence.
license  the licence you can point at, e.g. 'CC BY 4.0', 'CC0'.
